summary: Backend-only regression + v9 seed expansion verification. Catalog is now 164 products (65 cut-veg + 73 whole + 8 cut-fruit + 18 ready-mix). Added new focused test module test_v9_catalog.py (20 tests) covering total count, per-category counts, universal sku + local_name coverage, sku uniqueness, whole-catalog SKU prefixes, exact cut-fruit SKU→name mapping, ready-mix signature items (Daily Table Salad, Sambhar Mix, Biryani, Undhiyu). Refreshed 2 stale v7 assertions in test_freshcuts_api.py (catalog size >=80 → >=160; hard-coded 'Stir-fry Mix' / 'Biryani Veggie Mix' recipe test relaxed since new ready-mix SKUs ship with empty recipes list). Full suite 85/85 pass in ~6s against public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL.

minor.issue: Review request stated 'all with sku starting WHL/WL' but observed 3 items with WR* prefix (WRPP, WRCG, WRDG). Non-blocking - could be intentional variants.

New v9 ready-mix products (18) all ship with empty recipes list. Previous v7 items 'Stir-fry Mix' and 'Biryani Veggie Mix' with populated recipes were replaced/renamed. Consider adding recipes for at least anchor SKUs like Regular Vegetable Biryani Mix, Gujarati Undhiyu Mix.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py continues to grow with the WHOLE_CATALOG, CUTFRUIT_CATALOG, and READYMIX_CATALOG being appended inline. Strongly recommend extracting seed data (all catalogs + image maps + build_products functions) into a backend/seed_data/ package for maintainability once file exceeds ~1000 lines.

Ready-mix v9 SKUs ship with empty recipes list. If recipes were valuable in v7 (as the previous enrichment test assumed), consider back-filling recipes for the new SKUs so ready-mix continues to provide differentiated user value.
3 whole-catalog items use WR* SKU prefix while the rest use WHL/WL - if this is by design (e.g. 'wrapped') it should be documented; otherwise treat as data-entry inconsistency.
